# RajSSO Guide

> Independent bilingual (English/Hindi) guide to the Rajasthan SSO ID portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in). Covers login, registration, account recovery, government exams, linked services, scholarships, district help, and free browser-based tools. This is NOT the official government portal and never asks for SSO IDs, passwords, or OTPs.

Every page is available in English (/en) and Hindi (/hi). Replace /en with /hi for the Hindi version.

## Guides
- [SSO ID Login](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/sso-id-login): How to log in to the Rajasthan SSO portal safely.
- [SSO ID Registration](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/sso-id-registration): Create a new citizen SSO ID using Jan Aadhaar, Aadhaar, or Google.
- [Forgot SSO ID](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/forgot-sso-id): Recover a forgotten SSO ID or reset a password.
- [Merge SSO ID](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/merge-sso-id): Combine duplicate SSO IDs into one account.
- [All Guides](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/guides): Index of core SSO guides.

## Exams
- [Government Exams](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/exams): Rajasthan exams, OTR fees, and how to apply via SSO.
- [Exam Calendar](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/exam-calendar): Last dates and exam dates with a live countdown.
- [RPSC CET](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/exam/rpsc-cet): Common Eligibility Test details and OTR.
- [RSMSSB LDC](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/exam/rsmssb-ldc): Lower Division Clerk recruitment.
- [Patwari](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/exam/patwari): Rajasthan Patwari recruitment.

## Services
- [Services](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/services): SSO-linked government services.
- [PayManager](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/service/paymanager): Salary slips and employee pay details.
- [RajKaj](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/service/rajkaj): Leave applications and office workflows.
- [Jan Aadhaar](https://rajssoidguide.in/en/service/jan-aadhaar): Jan Aadhaar e-KYC and enrolment status.
